scope: Original full-test KV260 power recordings. Every evaluated input, including abstentions, contributes to the energy estimate. The two variants were measured in separate consecutive sessions, with identical input batches and the same input package.
normalization: All raw sensor samples, counters, input indices, timings and numerical metadata are unchanged. Absolute sensor and CPU governor paths are replaced with device-relative labels; source_sha256 identifies the original measurement JSON bytes.

analysis.weighting: Input-count-weighted batch estimates. The original board analysis.json uses equal batch weights and is a diagnostic summary, so its means need not equal the full analysis.
analysis.timing: Processing time is inverse throughput from item-counter increments during the sensor window. Whole-run item counts and elapsed time include other phases and must not replace this rate.
analysis.uncertainty: Approximate Student-t 95% intervals with B-p residual degrees of freedom, assuming independent, homoscedastic batch measurement errors conditional on workload. Sensor calibration uncertainty and training-seed variation are excluded.
analysis.standard_error: sqrt(s2 * sum(w_b^2)), where w_b are normalized input-count weights and s2 is OLS SSE/(B-p) conditional on events per input and, when varying, draws per input. This estimates uncertainty of the raw weighted mean.
analysis.mode_scope: modes_by_variant contains all eight variant/mode combinations. D0 energies are idle-adjusted before control subtraction; other modes are idle- and D0-subtracted. The existing modes keys retain the five main results.
